'''Jodd Zarfane''' was a retired officer of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a senator from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] dispatched a team to convince him to aid them in their fight against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. However, the man they met with was not Jodd Zarfane. The real Zarfane and his staff had been killed by Yuuzhan Vong agents attempting to infiltrate the [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] military.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
